references.text: Moses reminds the people that they were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord brought them out from there, as a basis for keeping the Sabbath.
The same exhortation to remember slavery in Egypt and the Lord's deliverance, used as a reason to treat slaves with kindness.
A reminder of slavery in Egypt as motivation for keeping the commandments, especially in connection with the festivals.
The Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, from the house of bondage, with a strong hand.
God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
The Israelites are to love foreigners because they themselves were foreigners in Egypt.
The Lord delivered Israel from the house of bondage and redeemed them from Pharaoh's hand.
The Lord delivered Israel from the house of bondage in Egypt.
Christ gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for himself a people for his own possession.
Believers are redeemed from their empty way of life by Christ's precious blood, as a parallel to Israel's deliverance.
